title: DocumentNode payload
description: The stable structural identity of one node of a document, independent of any version. Feeds the corpus `document_node` table (PRD §35.2), unique on `(document_id, stable_node_key)`.

node_kind.description: PRD §15.1 node taxonomy. NOT constrained to an enum here: packages/contracts publishes no `NodeKind` family yet (Q-CRPS-4 / FND-03).
